name: Evercraft Foundry App Escape Audit
problem: A founder or operator needs a clear portability, dependency, security and migration map for an app tied to a builder-specific runtime.
inputs: Authorized read-only project access or exported source/schema information.
outputs: Dependency map, route/schema inventory, security findings, provider-neutral architecture candidate, reconstruction manifest and migration/rollback plan.
confirmation: Explicit buyer authorization for source access and payment is required.
payment_authority: Evercraft Payments; direct machine checkout is not exposed for this service.
invocation_status: LIVE fixed-price human review handoff through the central Machine Commerce MCP tool prepare_quote_ready_service_handoff. Discovery and qualification are machine-callable; source access, payment and paid work remain explicitly human-confirmed.
authority_rule: Discovery never creates a payment obligation. Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation when supported. Checkout creation is not proof of payment. Paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
